gpu_accounting_policy: Count one allocated hour on any allowed GPU as one hour of the shared 24-hour cap; this is wall-time accounting, not A100-equivalent work or billing.
control_gate: Reuse the frozen successful PD-L1 control at the unchanged BindCraft revision, and require a new one-step GPU glycan-loss forward/backward preflight before Ig generation.
stopping_policy: Scheduler walltime takes precedence over attempt goals. MERTK final_designs is deliberately above the maximum possible variants, so a planned batch does not stop at the old four-design target. Report interruptions and actual counts.
nomination_policy: Automatically assess at most one preliminary native-context-passing parent per Ig epitope with the same three-seed AF3 protocol as controls. This is computational triage, not a native-binding or biological nomination.
